description: This file defines an abstract class 'QuizService' and its implementation 'MockQuizService' for fetching quiz data from a JSON asset in a Flutter application. It includes methods for retrieving quizzes and submitting quiz attempts.

classes.name: QuizService
classes.description: An abstract class defining the interface for quiz-related operations, such as fetching available quizzes and submitting quiz attempts.

classes.name: MockQuizService
classes.description: A mock implementation of QuizService that loads quiz data from a bundled JSON file.

methods.name: fetchQuizzes
methods.description: Fetches the list of quizzes from a JSON asset and decodes it into a list of Quiz objects.

methods.name: submitQuizAttempt
methods.description: Placeholder method for submitting quiz answers; currently simulates a delay.
